# dim_training_modules

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.dim_training_modules` · dbt area: `training`

Dimension table for training modules advisors are offered in Portal. Each row represents a single module with metadata and computed lesson count. Training modules can include multiple lessons. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `training_module_id` | Primary Key. Unique identifier for each training module. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `archived_at` | When the module was archived. NULL if the module has not been archived. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `count_total_module_lessons` | Current count of lessons (non-archived) within the module. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `created_at` | When the module was first created. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_archived` | True if the module has been archived. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `module_complete_time_minutes` | The estimated total time to complete the module (in minutes), as displayed to advisors. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `module_description` | Description of the module and its content. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `module_name` | Display name of the module. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `module_sequence` | Display order of the module within its track. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `track_id` | Foreign key. ID of the track the module is part of. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `updated_at` | When the module was last updated. >> SOURCE - Portal |
